title: Starling Bank CEO Raman Bhatia to step down - FT
text: As reported in the Financial Times, Starling Bank CEO Raman Bhatia privately told the group's board that he no longer wants to lead the fintech firm and will leave after just two years in the role.

title: Iceland prepares for domestic account-to-account payments infrastructure
text: The Central Bank of Iceland is preparing for new payments infrastructure that would enable banks and payment service providers (PSPs) to offer account-to-account (A2A) payments for goods and services, as the Nordic country looks to diversify its retail payment channels and strengthen financial resilience.

title: EPC publishes new Verification of Payee matching recommendations
text: The European Payments Council (EPC) has published an updated set of recommendations for matching processes under its Verification Of Payee (VOP) scheme, providing additional guidance on character handling and the assessment of beneficiary names ahead of payment initiation.

title: FCA sets out rules for ESG rating providers
text: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority has finalised new rules for ESG rating providers designed to raise standards and help investors to make better informed decisions.

title: OppFi abandons purchase of BNC Bank
text: Digital finance platform OppFi has withdrawn its applications buy a bank, claiming it has not had a "meaningful opportunity" to engage with regulators to address concerns about the deal.

title: Binance says hackers used fake job interviews and AI tools in $6.3bn hack
text: Binance says the $6.3 billion cyberattack it suffered last week was a sophisticated, multi-stage campaign that included fake job interviews, malicious software downloads and compromised AI tooling.

title: TD launches challenge to help Gen Z build financial confidence
text: Canada's TD is launching a challenge across its social and digital channels designed to help Gen Z build their financial confidence through daily activities and gamified experiences.

title: EU and Canada plan to link real-time payment systems
text: The European Union and Canada have committed to connect their real-time payment systems and to explore ways to open up their markets to each other's banks and fintechs.

title: Revolut lands New Zealand banking licence
text: Revolut continues its global expansion, securing a banking licence in New Zealand, making it the country's first digital lender.

title: Nyse tokenised securities platform gets on-chain shareholder services through Broadridge
text: Broadridge is planning to bring on-chain shareholder governance and digital transfer agency services to the New York Stock Exchange’s new tokenised securities platform.
